purpose: A redo of the blank business card from carry-props-01 (story/phone.md): the approved one (source 99) is clean and has rounded corners, and a Japanese meishi has square ones. The user asked for the cards to be fixed before the design goes into the game (2026-10-12). Blank: the game prints the name and number on it. Nothing goes into the game without the user's approval.

items.style: top-down flat lay photograph, shot on 35mm film, soft even light, fine film grain, muted colours, true to life wear and patina, sharp focus
items.subject: a single completely blank Japanese business card, a plain rectangle of thick off-white card stock with four sharp square right-angled corners, yellowed with age, the edges grubby and slightly frayed from years in a wallet, one corner bent over, a soft diagonal crease across it, a faint brown ring stain and grey thumb smudges, lying flat and seen straight down from directly above
items.composition: the card with its long side horizontal, centred and whole in the frame with a margin all round, isolated on a plain matte dark grey seamless background, nothing else in the picture
items.notes: Square corners, and as worn as the leather it lives in.
